ANCHORED regime: GLEIF keeps the LEI it issues, every other record is stripped, so the shared identifier is unavailable and name evidence is actually exercised. Names, official names and aliases are verbatim publisher strings; NO variant is manufactured. Never to be mixed with Operation DarkNet Delhi, the synthetic fixtures, or the P6.16 no-identifier corpus.
